phases.name: s2-mixed
phases.description: S2.6 live e2e: one Pi lead + one claude worker settle one trivial committed change; the per-runtime cost-row proof.
phases.objective: You are the lead seat of rig s2-e2e, working in the current directory (a git repo). 1. Create s2_mixed_marker.py containing exactly one function: def marker() -> int: return 42. 2. Delegate to the worker seat named 'worker' (send it a message with rig send): the worker must create s2_mixed_marker_test.py that imports marker from s2_mixed_marker, asserts marker() == 42, and prints s2-marker-test-passed. 3. When the worker's file exists, run: python3 s2_mixed_marker_test.py — it must print s2-marker-test-passed and exit 0. 4. git add s2_mixed_marker.py s2_mixed_marker_test.py and commit BOTH on the CURRENT branch (do not create a new branch). 5. Then close your queue item as done with no follow-on. Do not start any new work after closing.
